summary: Web-based clue/puzzle site where users create titled clues accessible via a URL path segment, with a Start flow to reveal the first clue and support for pasting rich media into clue content, plus a Windows Aero-style UI theme.
architectural_notes: Clue routing uses a dynamic URL segment after /echofields/ (e.g., /echofields/{slugOrCode}) to open specific clues.

existing_features.title: Change frontend routing and clue loading so clues are opened via the path segment after `/echofields/` (slug), e.g. `/echofields/something`, not only numeric IDs.
Display each clue’s title on the clue page and in any relevant lists/labels, using English user-facing text.

Implement Start gating for the first clue: the first clue must remain hidden until the user presses a Start button on the main (/echofields) page; if there are zero clues, the Start button must not show and must not function.

Update the clue navigation UX so that for clues after the first, users can progress by entering just the next slug (the word after `/echofields/`) and opening the corresponding clue (i.e., construct `/echofields/{slug}` automatically).
Extend the admin create-clue workflow to include an explicit "Create Clue" button that creates a new clue tied to a URL slug, and include inputs for both slug and title.

Support copy/paste of videos, images, and PowerPoint links into the clue content area by detecting pasted URLs and auto-inserting the existing supported markup formats: Markdown image `![alt](url)`, video `{{video:url}}`, and PPT `{{ppt:url}}`.

Apply a Windows Aero-inspired visual theme consistently across the website (home, clue pages, admin portal), including glass-like surfaces, soft gradients, and appropriate blur/transparency while keeping text readable in both light and dark modes.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add a 'Create Clue' button to create a new clue tied to a URL/path segment
Gate the first clue behind a Start button on the main page; first clue is hidden until Start is pressed
If there are zero clues, the Start button should not appear and/or should not function
Allow copy/paste of videos, images, and PPTs into the clue content area
Each clue should have a title field/displayed title
Clue solving/navigation: for clues after the first, progress by changing the URL segment after /echofields/ (e.g., /echofields/something) and allow entering 'something' to open the corresponding clue
Apply a Windows Aero look/theme across the entire website

Update the clue data model and APIs to support: (a) a human-readable URL path segment ("slug") per clue, (b) a title per clue, and (c) rich content per clue, while preserving existing clue order so there is a well-defined "first clue".
Add conditional state migration so existing deployed clue data (currently stored as plain Text per incremental Nat ID) is preserved when upgrading to the new clue record format.

projectName: Slug-based titled clues with Start gating, rich paste support, and Windows Aero theme
